proposedRoleDescriptions.color: Separate drawing colors from tool selection, focus and error roles. A user's canvas palette is not the application brand palette.
proposedRoleDescriptions.typography: Keep handwriting/sketch text options distinct from ordinary interface labels. The sampled default Times heading is not treated as a brand role.

limits.semanticRoles: Null roles are deliberate. Element measurements do not establish canonical site-wide roles or scales.
limits.visibility: Nonzero element geometry does not prove visibility through loaders or overlays. Computed family requests do not prove successful font loading.
limits.coverage: Selected desktop samples and a supplied reference image when available; no complete responsive, interaction or accessibility audit.
limits.sourceDifferences: The live canvas was not modified. No drawing, save, share or account action was performed; the default Times H1 is not treated as a visual brand token.
limits.ownership: Third-party reference, not an approved production pack.
